r2_definition: R2 = 1 - sum((target - prediction)^2) / sum((target - mean(target))^2). Flatten all windows and horizons within each battery/seed; average seed scores then give batteries equal weight. Horizon/window tables use their own target mean. Negative values are valid; constant targets or fewer than 2 values return NaN. R2 is a reporting metric only; checkpoint selection remains unchanged.
method: Original RMSE rechecked against raw sample arrays; R2 computed from the same arrays.
